mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% indicates restrictive monetary policy that increases cost of capital and compresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% (over a 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 0.5% signals accelerating inflation that triggers central bank rate hikes, reducing equity risk appetite and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% (over a 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL increases exceeding 0.3% in one month indicate aggressive monetary tightening amid inflation, amplifying negative equity return pressure over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.3% and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise > 0.3% (over a 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) reflects tight labor markets that sustain consumer spending growth, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5% (over a 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1400 thousand units signal strong consumer demand for housing, boosting construction and retail sectors and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 1400 (over a 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profit growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100 (over a 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS above 5.0% immediately increases short-term borrowing costs, triggering negative equity returns within 5 trading days due to reduced market liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% (over a 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Consumer spending (RSAFS) above 700,000 million dollars indicates robust retail activity that sustains corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS > 700000 (over a 5-year rolling window).
